controles.affirmation: Environ 17,8 Mds $ de dette nouvelle garantie par EA elle-meme et securisee par la quasi-totalite des actifs (hook et bloc "Dette massive assumee au closing")
controles.verbatim_source: "The obligations under the Credit Agreement are guaranteed by certain material domestic restricted subsidiaries of Parent, including the Company (subject to certain exclusions and exceptions), and are secured by substantially all assets of Parent and the guarantors, including the Company" MAIS "(ii) Parent, the Guarantors and the Unsecured Notes Trustee entered into the First Supplemental Indenture to the Unsecured Notes Base Indenture [...] pursuant to which the Guarantors guaranteed the Unsecured Notes on a senior unsecured basis."
controles.correction_proposee: Les 2 500 M$ d'obligations 8,750% dues 2034 sont garanties sur une base NON securisee : elles ne sont pas adossees aux actifs. La suretei sur "la quasi-totalite des actifs" ne couvre que les facilites de credit et les obligations securisees, soit environ 15,3 Mds $ sur 17,8. Reecrire : "dont environ 15,3 Mds $ securises par la quasi-totalite des actifs de la holding et de ses garants, dont EA, sous reserve d'exclusions habituelles ; les 2 500 M$ d'obligations 2034 sont garanties sans surete".

controles.affirmation: Plusieurs tranches de dette nouvelle contractee par la societe holding (Parent) le jour du closing
controles.verbatim_source: "On April 8, 2026, Parent closed its private offering (the “New Notes Offering”) of (i) $2,875.0 million [...] (ii) €1,080.0 million [...] and (iii) $2,500.0 million" ; les facilites de credit seules sont "funded on August 4, 2026".
controles.correction_proposee: Seules les facilites de credit (6 125 M$ + 1 725 M EUR de term loan B et 3 250 M$ de term loan A) ont ete tirees le 4 aout 2026. Les 6 455 M$ equivalents d'obligations ont ete emis le 8 avril 2026. Preciser les deux dates.

controles.affirmation: Dette NOUVELLE de l'ordre de 17,8 Mds $ contractee pour financer le rachat
controles.verbatim_source: "Net proceeds from the New Notes Offering, together with borrowings under the Credit Facilities, the equity contributions from funds affiliated with the Consortium and cash on hand, were used (i) to pay the cash consideration for the Merger, (ii) to finance the repayment, prepayment, repurchase, defeasance, redemption or refinancing of the Company's existing outstanding indebtedness" ; 10-Q : "Net carrying value of Senior Notes $ 1,486"
controles.correction_proposee: Une partie du produit refinance la dette existante d'EA (1 486 M$ de senior notes 2031/2051), donc l'endettement additionnel net est d'environ 16,3 Mds $ et non 17,8. Par ailleurs le total de 17,8 Mds $ resulte d'une conversion EUR/USD non explicitee par le document (les tranches en euros representent 2 805 M EUR). Preciser "environ 17,8 Mds $ de dette brute levee, dont environ 1,5 Md $ de refinancement de la dette existante".

controles.affirmation: Fusion finalisee le 4 aout 2026, chaque action convertie en 210 $ en numeraire, suspension de cotation avant l'ouverture du 5 aout, Form 25 puis Form 15
controles.verbatim_source: "was converted into the right to receive $210 per share in cash, without interest" ; "requested that Nasdaq suspend trading of Company Common Stock on Nasdaq prior to the opening of trading on August 5, 2026" ; "the Company intends to file a certification and notice of termination of registration on Form 15 with the SEC"

controles.affirmation: Parent et Merger Sub formes par un consortium PIF, Silver Lake et Affinity Partners
controles.verbatim_source: "Parent and Merger Sub are entities formed by an investor consortium comprised of The Public Investment Fund (“PIF”), private investment funds affiliated with Silver Lake Group, L.L.C. (“Silver Lake”) and private investment funds affiliated with Affinity Partners"

controles.verbatim_source: "a first lien term loan B facility [...] consisting of a $6,125.0 million tranche and a €1,725.0 million tranche, (ii) a $3,250.0 million first lien term loan A facility [...] (iii) a first lien revolving credit facility with revolving credit commitments of $500.0 million" ; "$2,875.0 million aggregate principal amount of 7.250% senior secured notes due 2033 [...] €1,080.0 million aggregate principal amount of 6.250% senior secured notes due 2033 [...] $2,500.0 million aggregate principal amount of 8.750% senior notes due 2034"
